hypothesis: A liquid US stock in a market and stock uptrend, with a short-term oversold RSI_6 reading and a bullish daily candlestick pattern on above-average volume, tends to rise over the following ten sessions more often than a matched SPY exposure.

signal_inputs.regime: SPY close > 20-session SMA on the signal close
signal_inputs.trend: stock close > 50-session SMA on the signal close
signal_inputs.oversold: Moomoo indicator-polarity item indicator_name == RSI_6 has polarity OVER_SOLD or SEVERELY_OVER_SOLD at the signal close
signal_inputs.pattern: Moomoo kline-shape ktype=2 for the completed daily bar has direction == BULLISH and kline_shape != 0
signal_inputs.volume: signal-day volume >= 1.2 x the mean volume of the prior 20 sessions
signal_inputs.liquidity: 20-session mean dollar volume (close x volume) >= USD 100,000,000

entry: next session open after all conditions are true at a completed close; market order assumption
selection: if more than three names qualify, rank by 20-session mean dollar volume descending, then alphabetically; at most three concurrent positions
exit: next open after ten sessions, or next open after a close with RSI_6 polarity OVER_BOUGHT or SEVERELY_OVER_BOUGHT, or next open after a close below the 50-session SMA
historical_evaluation: NOT POSSIBLE for this candidate: kline-shape and indicator-polarity expose only the current snapshot, so a historical signal series cannot be reconstructed without inventing provider logic. No historical return is claimed.

forward_observation.cadence: each US trading day after the 16:20 America/New_York close
forward_observation.minimum_observation: 20 trading days before any performance statement
forward_observation.evaluation: hypothetical next-open entries and exits under the stated caps and costs, compared with same-notional SPY and cash; no statistical-significance claim

capital_flow_secondary_analysis.purpose: test whether historical main net inflow carries information independent of price momentum
capital_flow_secondary_analysis.window: up to 500 provider daily observations ending 2026-11-17
capital_flow_secondary_analysis.measure: 5-session sum of main_in_flow divided by same-day dollar volume versus 20-session past return and next 5-session return
capital_flow_secondary_analysis.caveat: overlapping windows, descriptive only, not a strategy and not out-of-sample evidence

excluded: provider probability_up/profit_prob statistics as backtest evidence
